== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The later slip locates the +1 power modifier here and replaces ability-1 permanent pilots with ability-2 permanent pilots. The earlier text gives the named ships’ permanent pilots ability 2 without that filter. Both retain the −3 deployment modifier and the printed pilot symbol with 3 for any Star Destroyer.
